{{Quote|Knights! Zildrog's Wedge!|A Knight of Zakuul|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=5}}</ref>}}
'''Zildrog's Wedge''' was a combat technique deployed by the [[Knights of Zakuul]] where they would box in an opponent with debris, pulling it from the environment with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and slamming it into the ground to create a makeshift barrier.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />
